properties.name: developer-content-creator.github.webhook.enabled
properties.description: Enables or disables GitHub webhook processing.

properties.name: developer-content-creator.github.webhook.secret
properties.description: Secret used to validate GitHub webhook signatures.

properties.name: developer-content-creator.logging.masking.enabled
properties.description: Enables or disables sensitive information masking in application logs.

properties.name: developer-content-creator.logging.masking.replacement
properties.description: Replacement text used for masked sensitive information.

properties.name: developer-content-creator.logging.masking.mask-jwt
properties.description: Enables masking of JWT values in application logs.

properties.name: developer-content-creator.logging.masking.mask-email
properties.description: Enables masking of email addresses in application logs.

properties.name: developer-content-creator.logging.masking.mask-phone
properties.description: Enables masking of phone numbers in application logs.
